name: onlyoffice-devtools
description: Agent skills for building integrations with ONLYOFFICE developer SDKs and tools. The README lists the skills the plugin currently ships.

interface.longDescription: Skills that teach the agent to build on the ONLYOFFICE developer SDKs: embed ONLYOFFICE Apps (formerly DocSpace) into a web page with the Embed SDK, build and audit portal plugins with the Plugins SDK, and build React screens with the ONLYOFFICE UI kit. When a task matches, the agent loads the right skill, reads the SDK's documentation and types, applies the rules the documentation cannot state, and checks its work with the scripts the skill carries.
defaultPrompt: Embed the ONLYOFFICE Apps file manager in our CRM page
Add a context menu action to ONLYOFFICE Apps that converts the selected file
Build a settings form in our admin with the ONLYOFFICE UI kit
